name: distribution_repair
scope: Review all 1839 original event identities and every original multi-document case, preserving all 1282 previously supported field values. Resolve only formal implementation notices accompanied exclusively by verified repurchase-price or convertible-bond conversion-price adjustment notices. Keep every original candidate and every exclusion reason. No account, forecast, return or holding selects the review scope.
selection_requirements: The new selection path is explicitly opt-in through this protocol; older protocols retain their original candidate rule.

Exactly one non-companion candidate must remain and have an unamended formal dividend implementation title. Two implementation notices, mixed/unknown notices, corrections, cancellations, postponements or ambiguous identities remain unresolved.

A companion must have an explicit price-adjustment title, its complete normalized title in the PDF first page, the same labelled stock code, and body evidence containing the relevant price object, adjustment wording and a yuan-denominated number. Title matching alone cannot exclude a document.

Bind all candidate documents to their original receipt, issuer, title, catalogue date and SHA-256. Retain all original document metadata and role evidence; no replacement, duplicate suppression by convenience or silent removal.

Existing primary gross amount, record/ex/payment/listing date roles, structured-source agreement, precision, publication convention and unsupported-provider rules remain unchanged. New automatically verified facts are availability dates only; prior manual economic corrections remain preserved.
validation: Preserve the actually executed previous extractor and source review. Add adversarial tests for missing body support, wrong issuer/title, multiple primaries, amendments, mixed notices, duplicate IDs and unsupported documents before accepting the new path.

Rerun all 1839 events and require every prior accepted field value to remain supported. A real contradiction must fail acceptance and be preserved for separately registered resolution, never suppressed to maintain a count.

Independently inspect every newly excluded companion and selected primary with PyMuPDF text/geometry. Inventory every archived dividend amendment for affected issuers, review its event/period relevance, and block any unresolved conflicting amendment. Keep the metadata-only 137-event queue as a hypothesis, not an acceptance target.

Independently verify all additional dates and supporting gross/identity terms without calling the production extractor. Render complete relevant pages for each new role/layout family and every mismatch; preserve every failed reader and source check.

Keep active data, numerical/execution/planning modules, frozen ledgers and the current plan exact. Only distribution source selection and the semantic package version may change. Run local checks, ordinary reloads of all 48 active models, baseline file preservation, actual CI and remote byte verification before publication.
integration_gate: This source-only phase cannot change model inputs, dates, labels, account flags or the paper plan. Applying accepted fields requires its own registered rebuilding, full fitting, fixed-forecast and independent account/paper verification.
risk: Balanced attack, 8% warning, original high-water mark, latched/non-recovering risk, positive_score and legacy turnover remain unchanged. No alpha candidates or relaxed gates.
limitations: This reviews the frozen archive, not a certified complete history of every filing or amendment. Catalogue-plus-next-day remains a retrospective availability convention.
Companion-role resolution and verified dates do not certify all economic terms, taxes, fractional shares or complete event entitlements.
Current-universe bias, historical status/quote gaps, complete ETF exposure, competition execution details and future observations remain open.
